name: Blastic Plasmacytoid Dendritic Cell Neoplasm

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: WHO Classification of Tumors of Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Tissues

criteria.description: Presence of medium-sized blast cells with plasmacytoid dendritic cell morphology
Expression of CD4, CD56, CD123, TCL1, and absence of lineage-specific markers for T, B, and myeloid cells
Bone marrow infiltration by neoplastic plasmacytoid dendritic cells
Frequent chromosomal abnormalities including complex karyotypes and MYC rearrangements

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Morphologic evidence of blast cells with plasmacytoid dendritic cell features plus characteristic immunophenotype (CD4+, CD56+, CD123+)
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of other hematologic malignancies with overlapping features.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Cutaneous violaceous or bruise-like plaques and nodules
Expression of CD4 and CD56 on neoplastic cells
searchTerms: cancer cells expressing CD4 and CD56 markers
neoplastic cells with specific immune markers
tumor cells showing CD4 and CD56

common.symptomName: Bone marrow infiltration leading to cytopenias
common.notes: May cause anemia, thrombocytopenia, or leukopenia
searchTerms: bone marrow cancer causing low blood counts
blood cell deficiency from marrow disease

common.notes: Enlargement of liver and spleen due to infiltration

common.symptomName: Constitutional symptoms including fever and weight loss
common.notes: B symptoms common in advanced disease
searchTerms: fever, weight loss, and night sweats
general symptoms like tiredness and fever
systemic illness signs including weight loss

occasional.notes: Ulcerations or plaques in oral cavity

occasional.symptomName: Respiratory symptoms due to pulmonary infiltration
searchTerms: lung symptoms due to tissue buildup
stomach or bowel symptoms related to illness

rare.notes: Rare but possible in advanced disease
searchTerms: renal dysfunction due to tissue infiltration
eye involvement with masses around the eye
swelling or tumors in the eye socket

rare.symptomName: Psychiatric symptoms secondary to CNS involvement
searchTerms: psychiatric symptoms due to CNS disease

laboratory: Bone marrow biopsy showing blast infiltration
Immunophenotyping positive for CD4, CD56, CD123
imaging: CT or PET scans showing lymphadenopathy and organomegaly
genetic: Other chromosomal abnormalities detected by FISH or karyotyping
other: Skin biopsy demonstrating dermal infiltration by plasmacytoid dendritic cells

distinguishingFeatures: Absence of CD4 and CD56 co-expression

redFlags: Rapidly progressing cutaneous lesions with systemic symptoms
Neurological deficits suggestive of CNS involvement
references: WHO Classification of Tumors of Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Tissues, 2017
Pagano L, Valentini CG, Pulsoni A, et al. Blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm: state of the art and prospects. Cancers (Basel). 2020;12(7):1870.
